WoW: Forever

Survival Hunter

The Hunter that fights in melee, or in and out of it, with the trap talents alongside. It plays as a ranged Hunter until its melee talents arrive at level 30.

WoW: Forever · Melee DPS · Updated November 13, 2026 · Client build 1.60.1.70938 · Null Ossuary

Levelling and level 60 guide for the live game. The builds are Icy Veins' and Wowhead's, named and dated; both were written at or just after launch. Numbers are the client's with hotfixes through November 12. The level 60 playstyles cite Wowhead's builds and WoWSims, a model. Icy Veins' Survival guide still prints pre-launch racials, so this page uses it for its builds and rotation and not for verdicts it does not show work for. No raid is open until December 9. Where a hover tooltip and the text disagree, believe the text: tooltips can lag a hotfix.

What Survival is for

A melee rotation the other two trees do not have. Strider KickStrider KickTalentCastInstantCost5.81% of base ManaRangeMeleeCooldown8 sec cooldownDuration3 secA powerful kick that deals 100% melee weapon damage and increases movement speed by 30% for 3 sec. at 21 points is an instant attack for 100% weapon damage on an 8-second cooldown that also grants +30% movement speed for 3 seconds. Expose PreyExpose PreyTalent · Rank 2 of 2CastInstantGrants your melee and ranged attacks against enemies afflicted by Hunter's Mark a 10% chance to allow an activation of Mongoose Bite. Lasts 10 sec. gives your attacks on a Hunter's MarkHunter's MarkLevel 6 · Spell · Arcane · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantCost15 ManaRange100 yd rangeDuration120 secPlaces the Hunter's Mark on the target, increasing the Ranged Attack Power of all attackers against that target by 26. In addition, the target of this ability can always be seen by the hunter whether it stealths or turns invisible. The target also appears on the mini-map. Lasts for 120 sec.ed target a 10% chance at 2/2 to open Mongoose BiteMongoose BiteLevel 16 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantCost30 ManaRangeMeleeCooldown5 sec cooldownCounterattack the enemy for melee weapon damage plus 15. Can only be performed after you dodge., which otherwise needs a dodge. Predator's EdgePredator's EdgeTalent · Rank 5 of 5CastInstantIncreases your melee ability critical strike damage by 30% and your Off Hand weapon damage by 50%. raises melee ability crit damage and off-hand damage. Lacerating StrikesLacerating StrikesTalentCastInstantYour Mongoose Bite also causes the target to Bleed for damage equal to 40% of the damage done by Mongoose Bite over 21 sec at 31 points makes Mongoose Bite bleed for 40% of its damage over 21 seconds.

The speed from Strider KickStrider KickTalentCastInstantCost5.81% of base ManaRangeMeleeCooldown8 sec cooldownDuration3 secA powerful kick that deals 100% melee weapon damage and increases movement speed by 30% for 3 sec. is what makes weaving work: kick, then run back out to shoot. Icy Veins: learning to weave Raptor StrikeRaptor StrikeLevel 1 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 8CastInstantCost10 ManaRangeMeleeCooldown6 sec cooldownA strong attack that deals melee weapon damage plus 5. and Strider KickStrider KickTalentCastInstantCost5.81% of base ManaRangeMeleeCooldown8 sec cooldownDuration3 secA powerful kick that deals 100% melee weapon damage and increases movement speed by 30% for 3 sec. "will make a significant difference in your kill times," at the cost of Mana and of pulling threat off your pet when a melee ability crits.

The trap and defence talents sit beside it. EntrapmentEntrapmentTalent · Rank 5 of 5CastInstantWhen your traps are triggered, all affected targets are Entrapped, preventing them from moving for 5 sec. makes every trap you trigger root what it catches, 1 second per rank. Clever TrapsClever TrapsTalent · Rank 2 of 2CastInstantIncreases the duration of Freezing and Frost trap effects by 30% and the damage of Immolation and Explosive trap effects by 30%. lengthens the Frost traps and raises Fire trap damage. Survivalist's DisciplineSurvivalist's DisciplineTalent · Rank 2 of 2CastInstantReduces the cooldown of your Trap and Deterrence abilities by 40%. cuts the cooldown of traps and DeterrenceDeterrenceLevel 20 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCooldown300 sec cooldownDuration10 secWhen activated, increases your Dodge and Parry chance by 25% for 10 sec. by 40% at 2/2. DeflectionDeflectionTalent · Rank 5 of 5CastInstantIncreases your Parry chance by 5%. gives up to +5% parry, and DeterrenceDeterrenceLevel 20 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCooldown300 sec cooldownDuration10 secWhen activated, increases your Dodge and Parry chance by 25% for 10 sec. is +25% dodge and parry for 10 seconds on a 5-minute cooldown.

The sources agree the first 30 levels are the weak part. Icy Veins: "you should not go Survival if all you care about is damage or leveling quickly," and Beast Mastery or Marksmanship "both offer far better damage talents at low levels." Wowhead recommends playing Beast Mastery until level 32. Both describe solo kill speed before the melee talents exist. Icy Veins adds that fully built at level 30, melee "will just start to surpass ranged damage" on a single target.

Rotation

Before the melee talents, play it ranged. Icy Veins says you will "need to play as a ranged DPS for at least the first 40 levels if not more."

  1. Wowhead's weaving rotation for 60 is marked work in progress. Below level 10, kite backwards between shots to stay out of the dead zone.

What decides each press:

  • Stand still for Auto Shot. Blizzard's notes say Auto Shot needs 0.5 seconds standing still before it fires, and that it keeps firing while you cast Aimed ShotAimed ShotLevel 20 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 6Cast2 sec castCost75 ManaRange35 yd rangeCooldown6 sec cooldownAn aimed shot that increases ranged damage by 40. Aimed Shot shares its cooldown with Multi-Shot.. So the cast costs you no Auto Shots and walking does.
  • When to walk in. WoWSims' weave walks in once Auto ShotAuto ShotLevel 1 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantRange35 yd rangeAutomatically shoots the target until cancelled. has fired and back out once the melee swing has landed, so neither timer is wasted (WoWSims' model).

Stat priority

While levelling: weapon damage, then Agility. Icy Veins asks for a slow bow and a slow two-hander, or a slow main hand and fast off hand if you dual wield, with Strength and Intellect as secondary gains.

At 60 both sites list hit, then crit, then Agility. Wowhead says 9% hit for abilities and labels its list speculative. Icy Veins says 8%, and notes SurefootedSurefootedTalent · Rank 3 of 3CastInstantIncreases your hit chance by 3% and reduces the duration of movement impairing effects on you by 30%. supplies 3 of it. Dual wielding wants more hit than that for its white swings, on both sites' account.

What Forever changed for Hunters

  • Pets scale their stats off your gear, and can no longer receive player buffs that increase their stats. On November 10 Blizzard set pet Health to 115% of normal, down from a bugged 150%. Icy Veins' Survival levelling page recommends a Cat or Raptor with ClawClawLevel 1 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 8CastInstantCost25 FocusRangeMeleeClaw the enemy, causing 4 to 6 damage.; the client's family table is on the Hunter overview.
